review_evidence: README states that the project formalizes the de Finetti–Ryll-Nardzewski theorem and implements martingale, L² and Koopman proofs of the key implication.
88 of 104 Lean files contain proposition declarations spanning exchangeability/contractability, conditional independence, martingales, tail sigma-algebras, path space and ergodic machinery.
Representative public results include measure_eq_of_fin_marginals_eq, exchangeable_iff_fullyExchangeable and the deFinetti theorem API.
summary: Reviewed exchangeability; retain the de Finetti/exchangeability probability formalization.
